intro: Hong Kong is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Harbour skylines, dim sum and island hikes — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Hong Kong
paragraphs: Hong Kong (East Asia) is known for its city, food and shopping experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to December.

paragraphs: Direct flights from several Indian cities.
